pass.answer: Run either route from the project the plugin is installed in, since configure has no scope flag. For the rerun, -s defaults to user, so pass the scope claude plugin list reports; another scope adds an install record there and enables the plugin there. The value always lands in user settings.

fail.answer: Pass the scope claude plugin list reports.
fail.why: near miss: no default, no consequence, no value location

fail.answer: Use -s project and the value lands in the project's settings.
